# The New York Times

> > The New York Times is a leading global news organization providing comprehensive journalism, international reporting, and multimedia content across world affairs, politics, culture, and business.

NYTimes.com serves as the digital platform for The New York Times, offering access to current news coverage, a searchable archive of over 13 million historical articles, and branded content solutions through T Brand Studio. The site features extensive international coverage with correspondents reporting from regions including Europe, the Middle East, Asia, Africa, and the Americas.
